headline: Kuriboh
title: Kuriboh Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Kuriboh. What is it? It is a tiny Level one DARK Fiend with three hundred attack. What does it do? During damage calculation, when your opponent's monster attacks, you can discard Kuriboh from your hand, and you take no battle damage from that battle. How do you use it? Keep it in hand as a shield against a big attack that would finish you. It is in Starter Deck: Yugi Evolution. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Save it for the big hit
